gen-righteous-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding from the first glance, Righteous bends its letters like neon tubing of constant thickness. Anek Devanagari sits beside it, modern in feel, with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone.
gen-righteous-gf-armata: Commanding in feel, Righteous fills the line with generous bowls, its letters cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width. Armata stays contemporary, with spacious gaps between its characters.
gen-righteous-gf-athiti: Fat bowls and bent steel rod: Righteous is commanding and fun up top. Athiti takes over with a high mean line and a see-through gap in each s, so paragraphs keep moving without snagging.
gen-righteous-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono feels approachable, with clipped capitals beside its lowercase. Righteous does its best work as commanding display, curves meeting stems with no swelling, while the mono excels at text with open counters that breathe.
gen-righteous-gf-biryani: Big bowls, bent rod, loud fun: that's Righteous commanding the line. Biryani keeps text clean and approachable, with a large eye on every e and unclogged small counters, so reading flows.
gen-righteous-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads openly, its curves ending in clear openings. Righteous handles commanding display with a ruler-straight line weight, while the body font keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level in height.
gen-righteous-gf-comme: Commanding, playful lettering: Righteous carries the same visual mass in every letter part. Comme takes the text with a smooth, modern read, no clogged curves, lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-righteous-gf-duru-sans: Pipe-cleaner strokes, loud and fun: Righteous commands the top of the page. Duru Sans settles into a modern, clean read, with generous openings on small letters and bodies that dominate the line.
gen-righteous-gf-gafata: Righteous hits hard: bowls fill the line, strokes with exactly no contrast. It earns its keep big and brief, while Gafata, contemporary and professional, sets a tall band of letters with short stalks above.
gen-righteous-gf-gidole: Gidole is clean, with a high-set midline and terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades. Gidole does text quietly, drawn with neon-tube consistency, while Righteous does commanding display with bowls that fill the line.
